documents.name: AHHAA Science Centre
documents.summary: AHHAA Science Centre is a science discovery destination in Tartu, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A dense hands-on science centre with live demonstrations and experiments strong enough to anchor a day in Tartu for families.
